## E — Market signal: points, suspensions and restoration
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (NC-PTS-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Handbook-only observation, not market evidence: the point and suspension tables are long lists of near-identical numbers that learners struggle to memorize, which suggests demand for a table drill.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: North Carolina learner demand, pass rates, pricing, voice-of-customer quotes and ad hooks for the points, suspensions and restoration topic are unresearched.
